_readme: The first PriceList (D-143, as D-145 leaves it), as it will be submitted to the price topic.
The script submits THIS FILE. It fills exactly three fields and changes nothing else:
stampToken.tokenId   from app/deployment/<network>.json, once the token exists
stampToken.treasury  likewise
methods[].payTo      from POSTMASTER_PAYER_ID
They are null here because they do not exist yet, and null is the honest form of
'not known at commit time'. The schema requires the account-id pattern, so a fill
that did not happen is caught by validation rather than published.
asset, facilitator and rate.source are per-network constants and their source of
truth is app/src/ops/networks.ts; the script asserts this file agrees with it before
submitting, so the two cannot drift.
The numbers are RECORD (Sonic 2026-09-06 and 2026-09-07, ledger §E Q-6) and live in a
committed file rather than in code so that what the Postmaster charges is reviewable
as a document. §14.3: there is one schedule, it is on consensus before it is charged,
and it is the same for everyone (§4.5).
No validFrom: D-145 dropped it. §14.3:1794 selects the current price by the message's
own consensus timestamp, and a second notion of when a schedule begins would compete
with the one a Verifier actually uses. This key is absent, not null — the schema sets
additionalProperties: false and will reject it.
provisioning is omitted (§4.6, D-57). _readme is stripped before canonicalization.
